attrs.skip-delay-duration: Skip-delay window in ms, default 300: hovering another trigger within this window after a close opens it immediately
attrs.orientation: Layout direction: `horizontal` (default) / `vertical` (panel appears to the right of triggers)
attrs.columns: Panel grid columns, default 2 (mega-panel multi-column link cards)
attrs.backdrop: Show an overlay when open (clicking the overlay closes)
attrs.keep-mounted: Keep the panel DOM mounted when closed (crawler/SEO indexing)
attrs.arrow: Pointer arrow on the popup, shown by default; `arrow="false"` hides it
attrs.loop: Top-level arrow-key wrap-around toggle, default `true` (loops at edges); explicit `loop="false"` stops at the edges (aligned with menubar)

events.oas-select: An item was selected (top-level leaf link, panel link card or secondary sub-nav link), `detail: { value }`
events.oas-change: The open item changed (open/close semantics: dispatched when a group expands or collapses, NOT a leaf selection), `detail: { value }` (value is the open top-level item value; empty string = closed); listen to `oas-select` for leaf selection — do not use this event to navigate or close containers

slots.panel-footer: Marketing slot at the bottom of the panel: `<div slot="panel-footer">` (CTA cards etc.) renders a footer container inside the panel when it has content

attrs.label: Optional group title (not rendered by this component's panel — it only carries data, matching the `type: "group"` field of the JSON channel)

slots: Grouped navigation items (`oas-navigation-menu-item` children, flattened into the grid when the panel renders)

attrs.active: Current-page marker: the link renders `aria-current="page"` (applies to top-level and panel links)
attrs.description: Link-card description: rendered under the title in mega-panel mode
attrs.disabled: Disabled: renders aria-disabled and blocks clicks/keyboard/hover
attrs.href: Link URL: leaf items with `href` render as `<a>` (top-level and panel link cards)
attrs.icon: Icon name (`@oas-ui/icons` registry icon name): panel link-card icon
attrs.icon-color: Icon color: fixes the icon to this color (overrides the selected/disabled default); defaults to `currentColor` following the text color
attrs.loading: Loading: blocks interaction until data-driven recovery
attrs.sub: Boolean: when present its direct child items parse into `sub` (overlay second-level nav inside the panel); otherwise they recurse into `children` (inline secondary sub-nav)
attrs.value: Selection value (required): top-level triggers and panel items use it for open/select/keyboard

slots: Navigation item label content (default slot text; direct child items/group carriers are excluded)

attrs.duration: Animation duration (ms); 0 jumps straight to the target
attrs.to-fixed: Decimal places (`Number.prototype.toFixed`); when omitted, integer display
attrs.value: Target value; invalid values treated as 0

events.oas-finish: Emitted once when the animation reaches the target, detail `{ value: target value }`

attrs.group: Group title (optional): options in the same group render a consecutive group title (not selectable), items are indented
attrs.value: Option value (data-carrier field of the declarative child-element channel)

slots: Option label content (default slot text)

attrs.back: Whether to show the back button
attrs.subtitle: Subtitle text
attrs.title: Title text

slots: Body content (default slot, below the title row; not rendered when empty)
slots.back-icon: Icon slot for the back button; replaces the built-in chevron when present (empty comment nodes count as no content)
slots.breadcrumb: Breadcrumb in its own top row; compose with the oas-breadcrumb component (not rendered when empty)
slots.footer: Bottom action area (not rendered when empty)
slots.title: Rich title content slot; overrides the title attribute text when present
slots.subtitle: Rich subtitle content slot; overrides the subtitle attribute text when present

attrs.current: Current page (controlled; flipping updates this attribute)
attrs.page-sizes: Page-size dropdown options (JSON array), e.g. `[10,20,50]`; switching resets to page 1
attrs.show-jumper: Shows a quick-jump input 「跳至 __ 页」(Enter to jump, out-of-range clamped)
attrs.show-total: Shows the total text 「共 X 条」
attrs.siblings: Number of page numbers shown on each side of the current page
attrs.disabled: Disables everything: all page buttons with aria-disabled, plus the page-size dropdown and jumper input
attrs.size: Size tier: xs / sm / md / lg / xl (default md); invalid values fall back to md with a console warning
attrs.simple: Minimal form: only prev/next buttons and a "current / total pages" text; mutually exclusive with the page-number ellipsis algorithm (simple wins); show-jumper still applies
attrs.show-edges: Shows first/last double-arrow buttons (« »), disabled at the boundaries; aria-label via i18n
attrs.hide-on-single: Hides the whole component when there is a single page (pageCount ≤ 1)

events.oas-change: Flipping `{ page }`; page-size switch `{ page: 1, pageSize }`; quick jump `{ page, pageSize }`
events.oas-before-change: Fires before a page change/jump; preventDefault cancels the change (page-size switching is not intercepted)

slots.prev-icon: Icon slot for the previous button; replaces the default ‹ when present
slots.next-icon: Icon slot for the next button; replaces the default › when present
slots.total: Total text slot; replaces the built-in "Total N" text when present

attrs.copyable: Show a copy button that copies the text content on click
attrs.ellipsis: Single-line ellipsis when the text overflows its container
attrs.copy-text: Custom content to copy (defaults to the current text)
attrs.ellipsis-suffix: Suffix preserved when ellipsized (e.g. an expand link); works with `ellipsis` / `line-clamp`
attrs.actions-position: Action bar position: `start` (before the text) / `end` (default, after the text); pair with `slot="actions"`
attrs.line-clamp: Number of lines before multi-line ellipsis (positive integer); combinable with `ellipsis-suffix`
attrs.tag: Render tag: replaces the default element (e.g. `sub` / `sup` / `ins` / `em` / `strong`)
attrs.depth: Text softening tier: `1` / `2` / `3` (progressively lighter); only effective with `type="default"`

slots.actions: Action slot (copy/edit buttons etc.); position determined by `actions-position`

attrs.aria-invalid: Invalid state (synced to container and cells, marked danger)
attrs.value: Current value (controlled)

events.oas-cancel: Cancel: cancel button / Esc / outside click
events.oas-ok: Clicked "OK"; the bubble then collapses automatically

attrs.append-to: Portal mount target: the panel moves into the target container (`body` or a CSS selector) when opened and moves back into the host shadow when closed; for panels clipped by host containers (overflow)
attrs.arrow: Whether to show the arrow (default true; `arrow="false"` hides it, the element and `::part(arrow)` are kept)
attrs.arrow-merge: Merge the arrow with the panel corner (C1): a right triangle merges flush with the panel corner — legs collinear with the panel edges (their strokes continue the panel border band), tip pointing orthogonally toward the anchor; the matching corner radius is zeroed; only takes effect for *-start/*-end placements, center placements are unaffected
attrs.arrow-point-at-center: Make the arrow point at the trigger element's center (default points at the trigger's edge; the arrow still points at the anchor center when the panel is shifted by viewport-edge avoidance)
attrs.auto-adjust-overflow: Viewport-edge auto flip and avoidance (default true; `"false"` disables it, keeping the declared placement, which may overflow the viewport)
attrs.auto-close: Auto close after opening for the given duration in ms, e.g. `auto-close="3000"`; not set means no auto close
attrs.closable: Show a close button at the panel's top-right (`part="close"`); clicking it closes and restores focus to the trigger
attrs.close-delay: Generic close delay in ms (default 0; used by non-hover trigger paths, hover paths prefer hover-hide-delay)
attrs.collision-padding: Viewport-edge clamping padding in px (default 4), the gap kept when the panel avoids viewport edges
attrs.color: Color variant: `primary` / `success` / `warning` / `danger` (tinted panel background + semantic border, derived from tokens including dark variants); unset or invalid keeps the neutral panel
attrs.disabled: Disable the whole popover: click / hover / focus / contextmenu / trigger-keys triggers are all ignored; the host is desaturated and aria-disabled is synced
attrs.fallback-placements: Custom fallback sequence (comma or space separated, e.g. `"left, right"`): when the requested placement does not fit, each candidate in the sequence is tried for fit; the first fit wins, if none fit the last one is clamped; unset uses the default main-axis flip
attrs.focus-on-open: Moves focus into the first focusable element of the panel when opened
attrs.fresh: Keep updating the content while closed (by default the content is frozen while closed and the latest value is written when opened; with fresh the closed state keeps writing)
attrs.hover-delay: Hover-trigger open debounce in ms (default 150; falls back to open-delay when unset)
attrs.hover-hide-delay: Hover-trigger close debounce in ms (default 100; falls back to close-delay when unset)
attrs.hide-when-detached: Hide the panel when the anchor is fully detached from the viewport (the open state is kept, avoiding a panel floating off-screen)
attrs.initial-focus: Focus the element matched by the selector when opened (host light DOM first, including slot content; falls back to focus-on-open when unresolvable), higher priority than focus-on-open
attrs.modal: Modal mode: full-screen backdrop + focus trap (Tab cycles inside the panel) + scroll lock + aria-modal; clicking the backdrop closes
attrs.offset: Dual-axis offset: `"main distance"` or `"main distance, cross offset"` in px (default 8, 0), e.g. `offset="12, 20"`
attrs.open: Controlled display (boolean attribute; shows when present)
attrs.open-delay: Generic open delay in ms (default 0; used by non-hover trigger paths, hover paths prefer hover-delay)
attrs.placement: Popup placement (12 directions: four bases top/bottom/left/right each with -start/-end cross-axis alignment)
attrs.title: Title text
attrs.trigger: Trigger method: `click` (default) / `hover` / `focus` / `contextmenu` / `manual`, space separated for multiple (e.g. `"click hover"`)
attrs.trigger-keys: Toggle open when the listed keys are pressed while the trigger is focused (space separated, e.g. `"Enter Space"`); no key binding when unset
attrs.virtual: Virtual trigger mode (same as tooltip; no anchor element)
attrs.virtual-anchor: Virtual anchor element selector (used when virtual-x/virtual-y are unset)
attrs.width: Panel width: a number (px) / `"trigger"` (same width as the trigger) / any CSS value (e.g. `50%`, `240px`); unset keeps the default

attrs.show-text: Whether to show the percentage text
attrs.size: Circle diameter (px)
attrs.status: Status color; `error` red, `success` green; when unset and progress reaches 100, success green is shown

attrs.aria-label: Accessible name of the container; defaults to i18n
attrs.error-correction: Error correction level l/m/q/h (currently L only; the rest are normalized to l)
attrs.size: Rendered width/height (px)
attrs.value: QR code content text

attrs.name: Native group name (managed inside the group)
attrs.value: Option identifier

attrs.allow-clear: Clear to `0` when clicking the currently selected star
attrs.icon: Custom star icon (character or SVG markup)
attrs.value: Current score (controlled)

slots.extra: Action area, placed below the description

attrs.auto-hide: The scrollbar is shown only while scrolling/hovering, then auto-hides after a timeout
attrs.direction: One source for RTL detection: when neither the element nor its ancestors set `dir` explicitly, falls back to the `direction` (`ltr`/`rtl`) injected by config-provider
attrs.end-distance: Trigger distance for `oas-end-reached` (px, default `0`): within N px of the bottom/right edge counts as reached
attrs.height: Viewport height (px); when unset, grows with the content
attrs.scroll-shadow: Scroll edge shadow (CSS-only): the shadow fades at each edge as you scroll, hinting that more content exists
attrs.stick-to-bottom: Stick to bottom: when new content is appended and the user is at the bottom (≤8px), auto-scroll to the new bottom; never interrupts reading history
attrs.width: Viewport width (px); when unset, fills the host width

events.oas-end-reached: Fired when scrolling reaches the container bottom (or the horizontal right edge), `detail: { direction: 'bottom' | 'right' }`; re-arms only after leaving the edge

attrs.disabled: Disables the whole segmented control (explicitly, or inherited from the config-provider global disabled injection)
attrs.value: Selected value (defaults to the first option; controlled)

attrs.allow-create: Allow creating new options from the input value when nothing matches
attrs.clearable: Clearable (shows a clear button when a value exists; clearing dispatches `oas-clear`)
attrs.item-height: Fixed row height (px) when virtual scrolling
attrs.max-tag-count: Collapse tags beyond this count into `+N` in multiple mode (opt-in; without it tags wrap instead of collapsing)
attrs.options: Options, JSON array `[{ label, value, disabled?, group? }]`
attrs.remote: Remote search: no local filtering, typing dispatches `oas-input` for the host to request
attrs.searchable: Searchable (type to filter after opening the dropdown)
attrs.value: Current value (JSON array in multiple mode)
attrs.virtual: Virtual scrolling for large datasets: renders only the visible window (reuses oas-virtual-list); options with a `group` field fall back to full rendering

events.oas-clear: Clear button clicked, `detail: { value }` (value before clearing)
events.oas-input: Input in `remote` mode, `detail: { value }` (for host requests)
events.oas-option-render: Dispatched for each rendered option row, `detail: { index, option, element }` (element is the option label container; host can rewrite it into icon/rich text)
events.oas-tag-render: Dispatched when a multi-select tag renders, `detail: { value, label, element }` (element is the tag text container; host can rewrite it)

slots.template[slot=\"option\"]: Static option row template, cloned into each option label container; `[data-option-label]` nodes get bound to the option label
slots.template[slot=\"tag\"]: Static multi-select tag template, cloned into each chip text container; `[data-tag-label]` nodes get bound to the tag label

attrs.collapsed: Controlled collapse to an icon strip (present means collapsed)
attrs.items: Menu items JSON `[{label, value, icon?, iconColor?, group?, badge?, children?, actions?}]` (supports divider entries `{type:"divider"}`; children for nested submenus)
attrs.mobile-breakpoint: Mobile breakpoint (px); narrower than this becomes an overlay drawer
attrs.width: Expanded width; defaults to the `--oas-sidebar-width` token
attrs.active: Value of the currently-highlighted menu item (controlled: set/clear immediately re-renders highlight)
attrs.drawer-open: Mobile drawer open state (controlled: set opens, clear closes; auto-removed when breakpoint returns to desktop)
attrs.loading: Skeleton loading state (shows a pulsing skeleton when present; value sets row count, default 4)
attrs.hide-toggle: Hide the bottom collapse button (a built-in toggle always visible on desktop; presence hides it — host opt-out for static sidebars)
attrs.accordion: Accordion mode (when present: expanding one parent collapses the other parents at the same level; multiple parents can be open by default)
attrs.expand-on-hover: Temporarily expand the collapsed icon strip on hover (visual only; does not change controlled collapsed)
attrs.shortcut: Enable Ctrl/Cmd+B collapse toggling (off by default to avoid hijacking a global key)
attrs.side: Drawer side: left (default) / right (mobile drawer slides from the right, trigger on the right)
attrs.variant: Variant: sidebar (default flush) / floating (radius + shadow) / inset (radius + background contrast)
attrs.resizable: Edge drag-resize (shows a drag rail on the host edge; desktop non-collapsed only)

events.oas-collapse: `detail: { collapsed: boolean }`; When fired: Desktop collapse button toggled
events.oas-select: `detail: { value: string, label: string }`; When fired: A menu item was selected (also collapses the drawer on mobile)
events.oas-action: `detail: { value: string, action: string, label: string }`; When fired: an item hover action button is clicked (does not fire oas-select)
events.oas-resize: `detail: { width: number }`; When fired: drag-resize ends / arrow keys adjust the width

slots: Divider data carrier (no attributes; the host parses it as `{type:"divider"}`)

attrs.value: Selection value (data-carrier field of the declarative child channel)
attrs.icon: Leading icon (`@oas-ui/icons` registry icon name; shown in the collapsed icon strip)
attrs.group: Group name (consecutive items in the same group get a group title before the group's first item)
attrs.badge: Count badge (all-digit strings convert to `number`, otherwise stay `string`; matches `SidebarItem.badge`'s `string | number`)

slots: Sidebar item label content (default slot text); direct child `<oas-sidebar-item>` (and `<oas-sidebar-divider>`) elements recursively become the nested `children`

attrs.active: Whether to enable the shimmer animation
attrs.avatar: Whether to show the avatar placeholder
attrs.title: Whether to show the title placeholder

attrs.marks: Ticks: JSON object `{"0":"0°C"}` (value→label) or JSON array `[0,26,60]` (also `{"value":26,"label":"26°C"}`); tick marks and labels are shown below the track, highlighted where the value passes; positions mirror under `reverse`
attrs.range: Range mode: dual-thumb interval selection, `value` as JSON array `[lo, hi]` or comma-separated string `"lo,hi"`; thumbs constrain each other (lo ≤ hi), event `detail.value` is an array
attrs.reverse: Reversed direction: minimum on the right (track `dir="rtl"`), fill/ticks/custom thumb positions mirror

attrs.show-tooltip: Show a value bubble above the thumb (temporarily shown while dragging; coexists with `custom-thumb`)
attrs.value: Current value (controlled): numeric string for single mode; JSON array or comma-separated string for `range` mode

events.oas-change: Committed on release, `detail: { value }` (single number; `[lo, hi]` array in `range` mode)
events.oas-input: While dragging / after debounced typing commit, `detail: { value }` (single number; `[lo, hi]` array in `range` mode)

slots.template[slot=\"custom-thumb\"]: Custom thumb content (icon/text): `template[slot="custom-thumb"]` (static template, cloned into every visible thumb — both thumbs in range mode) or a plain `[slot="custom-thumb"]` element

events.oas-action: Dispatched when the action button is clicked
events.oas-close: Dispatched when auto-dismissing after timeout (controlled mode does not clear `open` itself)

attrs.direction: Direction; supports breakpoint shorthand: a space-separated base value plus any `breakpoint:value` pairs (e.g. `column md:row`), breakpoints `sm`=640px / `md`=768px / `lg`=1024px / `xl`=1280px (mobile-first min-width), base value applies below the breakpoint
attrs.fill: Make items grow equally to fill the container (the `flex: 1` equivalent)
attrs.fill-ratio: Ratio for `fill` distribution (percent, default 100): items can set it individually, container-level acts as default
attrs.reverse: Reverse the main axis: horizontal → `row-reverse`, vertical → `column-reverse`
attrs.separator: Separator string between items (secondary text color); `slot="separator"` custom content takes priority
attrs.size: Spacing: `xs` (4px) / `small` (8px) / `medium` (12px, default) / `large` (24px) / `xl` (32px), or a numeric pixel value; a comma-separated pair (e.g. `8,16`) controls horizontal/vertical spacing separately; supports breakpoint shorthand (e.g. `small md:large`, breakpoints as in `direction`); invalid values fall back to `medium` with a warning

slots: Items
slots.separator: Custom separator content (e.g. `<oas-divider direction="vertical">`), takes priority over the `separator` string

attrs.trigger: Trigger mode: `click` (default) | `hover` (open on hover, collapse on leave with a 120ms grace period; falls back to click on touch devices)

events.oas-open: Expanded/collapsed, `detail: { open, reason }`; reason is `toggle` / `outside` / `escape` / `select` / `hover` (source marker, backward compatible with the open field)
events.oas-select: A sub-action was selected, `detail: { index, label }`, then it collapses automatically

slots: Custom icon for the main button; when provided it replaces the default ＋ (45° rotation on expansion is preserved)

attrs.size: Indicator size: `xs` / `small` / `medium` (default) / `large` / `xl`; legacy abbreviations `sm`/`md`/`lg` remain supported
attrs.spinning: Whether loading; when set, wraps content with an overlaid mask

attrs.collapsed: Controlled collapse: when present, collapses the panel before the first divider (written back automatically on collapse; external set/remove takes effect immediately)
attrs.collapsible: Show a collapse button on the divider; click to collapse/expand the preceding panel
attrs.lazy: Lazy rendering: while dragging, only the divider moves visually; sizes are written back and panels re-rendered on release (for heavy panels)
attrs.max: Maximum ratio of the preceding panel: numbers as percentage, `200px` suffix clamps in pixels; invalid values fall back to 90
attrs.min: Minimum ratio of the preceding panel: numbers as percentage, `200px` suffix clamps in pixels; invalid values fall back to 10
attrs.sizes: Multi-panel mode panel ratios (comma-separated percentages, e.g. `30,40,30`); falls back to equal split when count mismatches panel count
attrs.vertical: Vertical direction: panels stack top-to-bottom, divider is horizontal, keyboard uses ArrowUp/Down

events.oas-collapse: Fired when the collapse button toggles, `detail: { collapsed, side }` (side=left means the panel before the divider)
events.oas-resize: Fired after resizing. Two-panel mode `detail: { percent }`; multi-panel mode `detail: { percent, index, sizes }`

slots.handle: Custom handle content inside the divider (icon/dots etc.); falls back to the default grip
slots.pane-${i}: Internal slot: assigned automatically per panel index in multi-panel mode; not for host use

attrs.value: Numeric value (number string)

slots.prefix: Leading content (icons/tags etc.; distributed content takes precedence over the `prefix` attribute text). For simple text use the `prefix` attribute
slots.suffix: Trailing content (icons/tags etc.; distributed content takes precedence over the `suffix` attribute text). For simple text use the `suffix` attribute

attrs.clickable: Steps are clickable to jump (boolean; enabled when present)
attrs.direction: Direction (forced to horizontal in navigation mode)
attrs.label-placement: Label placement: `vertical` (default, icon above title) / `horizontal` (icon and title on the same row)
attrs.linear: Linear mode: only steps with `index <= current` are clickable (boolean; enabled when present; future steps are blocked, clicks are silent)
attrs.navigation: Navigation mode: arrow bar with a bottom Previous/Next button row (boolean; enabled when present)
attrs.progress-dot: Progress-dot steps: dot indicators with a thin connector line (boolean; enabled when present)
attrs.steps: `[{ title, description?, status?, icon?, disabled? }]` JSON string

events.oas-change: Fired when a clickable step or a navigation button is clicked (including keyboard triggers); `detail: { index }` (0-based)

attrs.checked-text: Label shown when on; inside the track at medium/large/xl, outside at xs/small
attrs.color: Custom primary color for the on state, overrides `--oas-color-primary` (CSS color value)
attrs.size: Size: `xs` / `small` / `medium` (default) / `large` / `xl`; invalid values fall back to `medium` with a warning
attrs.unchecked-text: Label shown when off; inside the track at medium/large/xl, outside at xs/small

attrs.badge: Badge next to the tab title (number or text)
attrs.icon: Icon name shown before the tab title (reuses the `oas-icon` icon set, e.g. `mail`)
attrs.label: Tab text
attrs.value: Tab value
attrs.disabled: Disable this tab: not focusable/clickable, `aria-disabled`, visually dimmed, skipped by keyboard navigation
attrs.editable: Tab is renameable on double-click: enters an input editing state, Enter confirms (emits `oas-rename`) / Esc cancels
attrs.href: Render the tab as a link: the tab becomes an `<a>` (anchor semantics: open in new window/middle-click/SEO-crawlable), works with target/rel
attrs.icon-only: Icon-only tab: renders only the icon without text (label provides the aria-label fallback for an accessible name)

attrs.bordered: Full border: draws a grid outline around cells (the outer frame is built in)
attrs.columns: Column config `[{ key, title, sortable?, width?, align?, fixed?, render?, summary?, editable?, editor?, editOptions?, actions? }]`, JSON string (declarative attribute channel; property assignment takes precedence)
attrs.data: Row data `[{ [key]: value, children?, expand? }]`, JSON string (declarative attribute channel; property assignment takes precedence)
attrs.editable: Inline editing switch (requires `editable: true` on columns; same for the `actions: true` operation column)
attrs.edit-controlled: Controlled editing: does not write back `data` on submit, only fires `oas-edit`; the host listens and updates `data` itself
attrs.expanded: Set of expanded row keys (comma-separated; shared by tree parent rows and expandable rows)
attrs.height: Virtual scroll viewport height (px); when set, only visible-window rows plus head/tail placeholders are rendered
attrs.loading: Loading state: shows placeholder rows in the data area (header retained)
attrs.row-height: Fixed row height for virtual scrolling (px)
attrs.row-key: Unique key field of a row
attrs.sticky-rows: Number of sticky rows (N): the first N rows stick below the header (coexists with the scroll container and fixed columns)
attrs.stripe: Zebra striping: alternating light background for odd/even rows
attrs.summary: Summary config `[{ key, type: 'sum'|'avg'|'count', label? }]`, JSON string

attrs.addable: Shows a + button at the end of the tab bar; clicking fires `oas-add` (the component does not add a panel)
attrs.closable: Shows a close × on every tab; clicking fires `oas-close` (the component does not remove the panel)
attrs.size: Tab size: `xs/small/medium/large/xl` (default medium), font-size/padding follow the step; invalid values fall back to medium with a warning

attrs.activation: Keyboard activation: `auto` (default, arrow keys switch immediately) / `manual` (arrows move focus only, Enter/Space switches — a11y manual activation)
attrs.animated: Selection transition + panel fade-in (animates color/border/opacity only, no layout)

attrs.trigger: Switch trigger: `click` (default) / `hover` (switch on hover; disabled tabs not triggered)

attrs.stacked: Icon on top, text below (vertically stacked tabs)
attrs.hide-indicator: Hide the active indicator line (the ::after underline in line mode)
attrs.scroll-position: Scroll alignment when scrolling the active/added tab into view: `auto` (default nearest) / `start` / `center` / `end`
